author: Clijmart
body:
Ye ye, anotha one!
This time with extra ingame features I haven't seen before :)
Not sure if they can all be used, but let's hope they will!

Map name: PonyLands
Team Names: Ponies VS Unicorns
Info: Uses horse spawners!
Creators: Clijmart, Acytlon, MilkyWayRules

This is a really big map, so traveling with horses would be a great thing to have.
Hope you like it :)

- Clijmart

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Congratulations!

Your Map, Pony Lands, has been accepted for testing!



Here are some Map Developer Comments:

"Remove the diamonds" - Fouled, Edans, Tazz

"looks good, remove diamonds, but idk how it will play, needs testing" - Xuph


As stated above, You should remove some diamonds before we do anything with the map :P


Please add me on Skype (Sethskye) if you have Skype so we can go on further details on Testing or on how to improve this map more or you can find me on The Avicus TeamSpeak.
